descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S21 「交接 AI 调用的时间和模型，每个模式 ×10」 Handoff AI call time and model, ×10 per context

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U10 Handoff AI calls follow 3.5/3.9: timings are targets with 30 s as the upper limit for investigation; each call logs the AI provider's own time separately from the total and which model answered; …（UAT 3.5；UAT 3.9） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given The H-01 (Hospital) and N-01 (Nursing Home) fixtures

When Generate each handoff 10 times through the app's own path

Then Each call returns; durationMs and providerMs are logged per call in aiCallLog (fn assist.generateHandoff) with the model that answered and any fallback

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：reviewOverMs 30000 per call (3.5 investigation limit, Q10): timings are targets, so a call over the limit is flagged for review, never Fail. providerMs missing on a row is a finding (3.5 'logs how long the AI call itself took'). The physician's sheet-level wait is recorded in S01 and S10

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PERF · 性能计时；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-08.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PERF · 性能计时；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
